title: The formation of young massive clusters triggered by cloud-cloud collisions in the Antennae galaxies NGC 4038/NGC 4039
question: Whether cloud-cloud collisions trigger the formation of super star clusters (SSCs) in the overlap region of the Antennae galaxies (NGC 4038/NGC 4039), and how compressed gas pressure relates to SSC stellar mass.

recipe.goal: Re-image ALMA Cycle 0 and Cycle 4+0 12CO (3-2) visibility data and evaluate missing flux
recipe.method: Re-image archival visibilities using multiscale CLEAN with natural weighting in CASA, and compare smoothed 14 arcsec peak brightness temperature to JCMT single-dish data
key_parameters: natural weighting; velocity resolution 5.0 km s^-1

recipe.goal: Compute moment maps, position-velocity diagrams, and define cloud velocity components and bridge features
recipe.method: Compute 0th, 1st, and 2nd moment maps using MIRIAD with a 1.5 K (1 sigma) clipping threshold; construct Declination-velocity and R.A.-velocity diagrams to separate blue, green, red, and intermediate-velocity bridge components
key_parameters: Clipping threshold > 1.5 K (1 sigma) for 1st and 2nd moments; V_LSR integration range 1300-1795 km s^-1 for total intensity

recipe.goal: Derive physical parameters and masses (virial and X_CO) of the cloud components
recipe.method: Fit Gaussian profiles to spectra at the maximum integrated intensity position of each cloud, measure effective radius enclosed by the 20% peak contour, and calculate M_vir and X_CO mass
key_parameters: 20% of peak integrated intensity contour (~30 sigma) for cloud boundary and effective radius r = (A/pi)^0.5
assumptions: Uniform density sphere for virial mass: M_vir / M_sun = 210 r (dV)^2
CO-to-H2 conversion factor X_CO = 0.6 x 10^20 cm^-2 (K km s^-1)^-1

recipe.goal: Quantify spatial displacement between complementary colliding clouds and estimate collision timescales
recipe.method: Shift one velocity component relative to the other in 1.8 pc pixel steps up to +/- 240 pc, compute Spearman's rank correlation coefficient of integrated intensities to find the minimum, and divide displacement by relative velocity
key_parameters: Shift range +/- 240 pc, step size 1.8 pc (1 pixel)
assumptions: Collision angle to the line of sight theta = 45 deg (range 30 to 60 deg)

recipe.goal: Evaluate gravitational binding and stellar feedback energy budgets
recipe.method: Calculate gravitational binding mass M = l sigma^2 / (2G) for SGMC 4-5, and compare cloud kinetic energy to supernova and stellar wind energy injection
key_parameters: Expansion velocity ~50 km s^-1 (half of velocity separation)
assumptions: Supernova kinetic energy conversion efficiency of 5% (Kruijssen 2012); stellar wind energy conversion efficiency of 20% (Weaver et al. 1977)

recipe.goal: Calculate external compressed gas pressures and fit correlation with SSC total stellar mass
recipe.method: Calculate external pressure at cloud edge P_e = (3 Pi M v^2) / (4 pi R^3) = rho_e v^2 for Antennae SSCs, R136, and Westerlund 2, and perform linear regression in log-log space using MPFITEXY
key_parameters: R = 150 pc extraction radius around C, D, D1, and D2
assumptions: Edge-to-mean density ratio Pi = 0.5 (rho_e = Pi * rho)
HI column density conversion N_HI = 1.8224 x 10^18 integral(Delta T_b dv) cm^-2 for R136
